description: Rajasthan Forest Department map files used by scripts/build-boundary-layers.py. Paths are relative to Data/source-materials/gis/. Each file is byte-identical to the copy served at source_url on the download date; the build stops if a SHA-256 does not match.
register_note: The register's protected-area table is headed 'Last Updated kml as on 31.07.2018' and its ESZ column 'ESZ KML as on 01.06.2026'. The Forest Department describes these files as for management use, not legal purposes.

reserve_2013_file.title: Forest Department file 'Mukundara Tiger Reserve.kmz' (Tiger Reserve boundary)
reserve_2013_file.note: File attributes: NOTIFY_ARE 759.99, DIGITIZED 744.85. Draws the 2013 reserve only, although the server copy is dated 24 Feb 2025.

np.title: Forest Department file 'Mukundara Hills National Park.kmz'

darrah.title: Forest Department file 'Darrah Wildlife Sanctuary.kmz'
darrah.instrument: Darrah Sanctuary order F 39(2) Forest/55, 7 Nov 1955

jawahar_sagar.title: Forest Department file 'Jawahar Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary.kmz'

bhainsrorgarh_wls.title: Forest Department file 'Bhensrodgarh Wildlife Sanctuary.kmz'
bhainsrorgarh_wls.instrument: Bhainsrorgarh Wildlife Sanctuary notification; added to MHTR core by F.3(22)Forest/2023, 5 Oct 2023

esz_2020_envelope.title: Forest Department file 'MHTR.kmz' (ESZ outer limit)
esz_2020_envelope.note: Outer envelope of the reserve plus its eco-sensitive zone, not the ESZ band alone.

esz_bhainsrorgarh_2021.title: Forest Department file 'BHAINSROAD ESZ.kmz'
esz_bhainsrorgarh_2021.note: Sanctuary plus a variable-width band. Its BUFF_DIST attribute (3000) does not describe the drawn band.

kota_buffer_blocks_2023.title: Forest Department file 'KOTA.kmz' (Kota district forest blocks)
kota_buffer_blocks_2023.note: Only the three 2023 buffer blocks added whole: Barkheda 90.76 ha, Rawtha 45.35 ha, Borabas-B 137.81 ha. The file draws Borabas-B at 49.85 ha against its notified 137.81 ha.

kota_blocks_2023_partial.title: Forest Department file 'KOTA.kmz' (Kota district forest blocks)
kota_blocks_2023_partial.note: Whole blocks that contain 2023 buffer additions smaller than the block: Bardkalan Kishor Sagar 30.67 km², Akelgarh 27.84 km² (listed without a part mark; 7.75 km² of the block was core in 2013), Sakatpura compartments 17, 20 and 21 (4.10 km²). The notified parts have no outline of their own in any public file.

bundi_blocks_2023_partial.title: Forest Department file 'BUNDI.kmz' (Bundi district forest blocks)
bundi_blocks_2023_partial.note: Whole blocks that contain 2023 buffer compartments: Karondi compartments 10–20 (8.57 km²), Rampuriya compartment 9 (0.27 km²), Dhaneshwar compartment 11 (0.68 km²). Ambarani-A (3.54 km², unclassed) is not in the file.
